learning_outcomes.text: Model and solve problems related to the business system
Make decisions related to production management

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required for the theoretical block (T1) and a minimum of 4 out of 10 for the practical block. The final theoretical grade is 0.65 * T1. The final practical grade is 0.35 * [(P1 + P2 + P3 + P4)/4]. If all minimums are reached, the final grade is Theory + Practices; otherwise, the final grade is the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical exam and a practical exam are conducted, each requiring a minimum of 4 out of 10. The final grade is (0.65 * Theoretical Exam) + (0.35 * Practical Exam); otherwise, the final grade is the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. Students with differentiated evaluation will have their practical activities replaced by a single individual practical test, while other conditions remain the same.
